title: Von Braun oversaw slave labor camp

tellings.quote: Yeah, Wernher Von Braun oversaw a brutal, mostly Jewish slave labor camp where tons and tons of people died.

plain: Michels says that Wernher von Braun, the German rocket engineer later brought to the United States to build rockets, oversaw a brutal slave labor camp in 1940s Germany, whose prisoners were mostly Jewish and where very many died. He says this himself, without naming a source, in his 2023 interview with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who went public about UFO secrets. He raises it as a reminder of the kind of men the American government was willing to take in after the war.
